You will hear Amy and Dad planning a visit to the sports centre.
Dad: Do you want to swim on Saturday?
Amy: The pool is full then. Can we go on Sunday?
Dad: Yes. Your lesson starts at ten.
Amy: Can we get there at half past nine so I have time to change?
Dad: Of course. Are we taking the bus?
Amy: Let’s cycle. The weather looks good.
Dad: Good idea. Have you got your swimsuit?
Amy: Yes, but I need a new towel. We can buy one at the sports shop.
Dad: What do you want to do after the lesson?
Amy: I want to watch the basketball match in the gym. My friend is playing.
Dad: All right. We can have lunch after that.
